senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. לוּז IV)to talk, esp. to scorn, scoff.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:12">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 1:1">Ps. I, 1</cite>) <he>אם ישב סופו לָלוּץ</he> if he sits (with scorners), he will finally scoff; <he>ואם לץ וכ׳</he> and if he scoffs, the Scripture says of him &c.; <cite ref="Psalms 1:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 1</cite>.

senses.gloss: (with אחר) to talk behind a person, sneer, deride.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52:2">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> beg. <he>היו מְלִיצִין אחריו</he> they derided him (Moses); (Yalk. ib. 417 <he>מִתְלוֹצְצִים עליו</he>).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מְלִיצִים אחר משה</he> (Yalk. l. c. <he>מתלוצצים</he>); a. e.

senses.gloss: (with בעד) to speak in behalf of; to defend; to interpret.—
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:8">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 42:23">Gen. XLII, 23</cite>) <he>המֵלִיץ זה מנשה</he> ‘the interpreter’ that means Manasseh.

senses.gloss: to talk frivolously, make light of, scoff. Ab. Zar. l. c. כל המִתְלוֹצֵץ ייסורין וכ׳ whoever speaks frivolously will be visited with suffering. Ib. (in Chald. dict.) I beg you דלא תִתְלוֹצְצוּ not to scoff.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:14">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מתלוצץ בעוברי עבירה</he> (Rashi: <he>בעבירה</he>) made light of sinners (Rashi: of sin) (spoke as though temptation could never have power over him). Yalk. Ex. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 1:6">Midr. Prov. to I, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01564"><he>מְלִיצָה</he></cite>; a. e.
